scripts.//test: --workspace-concurrency=1 because apps/api, apps/worker and packages/corpus-cli all run their integration suites against ONE Postgres. pnpm runs sibling packages concurrently, so without this they interleave: corpus-cli stands every playbook down to reach a fresh-node state while the worker's deadline runner is mid-seed. That is a race, not a fixture bug — it would surface in CI as an intermittent failure in whichever suite lost, which is strictly worse than a slower run.
